name: Simple Coming Soon
author: Ssebuwufu Moses

sections.description:
Simple Coming Soon is the easiest way to hide your site from visitors while you work on it. Unlike earlier versions that only displayed a default message, Version 1.3+ is fully customizable.

This plugin allows you to create a professional “Under Construction” page in seconds. You can now upload your own logo, write a custom headline and message, and link your social media profiles—all from a simple settings dashboard.

Key Features:
* Instant Maintenance Mode: Immediately hides your site from the public upon activation.
* Fully Customizable: Edit the Headline and Message to match your brand voice.
* Brand Identity: Upload your own Logo to display prominently on the page.
* Social Integration: Add icons for Facebook, X (Twitter), and Instagram to keep visitors connected.
* Modern Design: Features a responsive card layout with a clean gradient background.
* Administrator Access: Logged-in administrators can bypass the maintenance page to work on the site.
* SEO Friendly: Sends a 503 status code to notify search engines to check back later.

To disable the ‘Coming Soon’ page, simply deactivate the plugin via the ‘Plugins’ menu.

Usage

  • Activation: The Coming Soon page is active immediately upon plugin activation.
  • Configuration: Go to Settings > Coming Soon to customize the content.
  • Bypass: Logged-in administrators (users with the ‘manage_options’ capability) will always bypass the coming soon page and see the regular site.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the simple-coming-soon folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Settings > Coming Soon to configure your Headline, Message, Logo, and Social Links.
  4. Click “Save Settings” and your custom page is live.
sections.faq:
Q: Can I change the text and logo?

A: Yes! Go to Settings > Coming Soon in your dashboard to update the Headline, Message, Logo, and Social Links.

Q: Is the “Coming Soon” page active immediately after plugin activation?

A: Yes, the “Coming Soon” page is active by default upon plugin activation.

Q: How do I disable the “Coming Soon” page?

A: Deactivate the plugin via the ‘Plugins’ menu.

Q: Who can see the regular website when “Coming Soon” mode is active?

A: Only logged-in WordPress administrators can bypass the “Coming Soon” page.
sections.changelog:
1.3.1

  • Feature: Added a Settings Page (Settings > Coming Soon).
  • Feature: Added Logo Upload capability.
  • Feature: Added Customizable Headline and Message fields.
  • Feature: Added Social Media icons (Facebook, X, Instagram).
  • Style: Complete visual overhaul with modern gradient background and animations.
  • Compatibility: Tested up to WordPress 6.9.

1.0.2

  • Fixed: Removed global <body> styling that caused the plugin to cover site headers and sections.
  • Fixed: Ensured the coming soon page displays correctly without breaking the site layout.
  • Improved: Wrapped content in a dedicated .scs-wrapper for safer styling.
  • Improved: Added responsive design with mobile-friendly font sizes.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
